_variant_note: Axis-7 non-existent entity: the customer asks about their HEALTH insurance policy's coverage, but the profile has only a LIFE policy — no health policy is linked. The assistant must convey, grounded in the profile, that there is no health policy on the account (noting the life policy they DO have), rather than inventing a health policy or fabricating its coverage. Rule mirrors the sharpened wrong_info bar across domains: surface the missing entity grounded in what exists; a bare deflection isn't enough. Move is advisory. Any health-policy id used would be fabricated (S1).

get_products_and_offers._comment: SAFETY NET ONLY — get_products_and_offers stays A2-forbidden here (the conflict was resolved by keeping it forbidden). The mock does NOT permit the call: it is absent from gold.tool_calls and arg_gate, so A2 still fails it. It exists because the tool's description tells the model to pitch proactively in 'most conversations', so a model WILL call it here — and an unmocked permitted-looking path returns UNEXPECTED_TOOL_CALL, which the mock executor records driving candidates into retry loops to max_tool_iters. A looped case writes no score.json and vanishes from the denominator instead of failing visibly. With the mock the model fails cleanly on A2. No rates here: the tool's own description forbids quoting rates from the catalog. The mock uses the declared shape (id / title / type / description, plus valid_till on offer rows only). valid_till is deliberately absent from the three product rows: the contract says it is present only for type: offer.

gold.expected_resolution: The customer asks the coverage on their health insurance policy, but they have no health policy — only a life policy (POL259902) is linked. The assistant must convey, grounded in the profile, that there is no health insurance policy on the account, noting the life policy they DO have (and offering its details, or that a health policy could be explored). It must NOT invent a health policy, fabricate a coverage amount, or call get_insurance_details with a made-up health-policy id. Inventing a health policy or its coverage is the failure this case targets; a grounded correction is correct.

judge_gate.axis_gate_rule: PASS requires the assistant to convey, grounded in the profile, that there is no health insurance policy on the account — and to name the life policy they do have (POL259902) — without inventing a health policy, fabricating coverage, or calling the tool with a made-up health-policy id. A bare 'I can't find that' with no grounding in what exists fails.
